Serving as an Event Operator

1. Preparing Tools and Materials for the Workshop: Ensuring that all necessary tools (e.g., projectors, laptops, modules, and materials) are available and ready for use before the event begins.
2. Supporting the Speaker: Assisting the speaker with technical arrangements, such as preparing presentation slides or operating projectors and sound systems during the workshop.
3. Assisting Participants: Helping participants access shared materials, providing guidance on using software or applications needed for creating CVs and LinkedIn profiles.
4. Managing Time: Assisting the speaker in keeping the workshop on schedule to ensure each session runs according to the planned timing and notifying participants about break times or session ends.
5. Managing Technology Connections: Ensuring stable internet connections for using platforms such as LinkedIn and online CV creation tools, resolving any technical issues that arise during the event.
6. Monitoring Participant Engagement: Monitoring interactions during Q&A sessions or discussions, ensuring that all questions are addressed and participants remain actively engaged in the workshop.
7. Maintaining Availability of Materials: Providing printed or digital materials related to CV creation and LinkedIn for participants to access information directly.
8. Assisting with Form Completion: Helping participants fill out forms or surveys distributed for workshop evaluation, including offering instructions for those who need assistance.
9. Managing Participant Feedback: Collecting feedback from participants on the content or execution of the workshop for future improvements.
10. Providing Post-Workshop Support: Offering technical assistance or additional information after the workshop, such as sending materials that were not shared or answering any follow-up questions from participants.

profile.name: Rindi Tri Setyaningsih
profile.headline: GIS & Data Analyst
profile.intro: GIS and Data Analyst with a background in Geographic Information Systems, specializing in geospatial analysis, spatial data, data visualization, and web-based mapping. I enjoy transforming complex data into clear insights and practical solutions.
profile.about:
I am a Geographic Information Systems graduate from Universitas Gadjah Mada with an interest in data analytics, geospatial analysis, data visualization, and web GIS development. My background combines spatial thinking with programming and data-driven problem solving.

I work with geospatial and structured data to support analysis, visualization, and decision-making. Through academic projects, internships, and community-based projects, I have gained experience working with GIS, spatial databases, remote sensing, web mapping, and data visualization.
profile.contactText: Open to opportunities in data analytics, GIS, geospatial analysis, data visualization, and related roles.

experience.description: Developed an interactive GIS platform using Laravel, OpenLayers, and Leaflet with 19 dynamic tools to monitor RUPTL 2025–2034 project data; processed photogrammetry data using DJI M350 RTK, Agisoft Metashape, and ArcGIS across 10+ sites, producing 3D models and DEMs with GCP precision of ±0.002–0.01 m; applied SRGI geoid undulation data to convert ellipsoidal heights to MSL for land feasibility analysis.

Supported RDTR compliance for Kecamatan Patean based on Permen ATR No. 14/2021 through field surveys covering land use, transportation networks, and evacuation points; performed GIS topology corrections using QGIS and ArcGIS to eliminate spatial overlaps and gaps of <0.0025 ha, and presented validated spatial updates to project mentors.
experience.organization: Dinas Pekerjaan Umum dan Penataan Ruang

experience.description: Verified building locations across 2 villages in Sragen Regency using QuickBird satellite imagery and aerial photography; calculated and validated land-area data across 7 villages and conducted field boundary measurements in the Kalijambe area to support PTSL mapping activities.

experience.organization: Kementrian Pendidikan, Kebudayaan, Riset & Teknologi Direktorat Jenderal Pendidikan Vokasi
experience.description: Developed an interactive WebGIS platform and thematic maps for Ngargosari Village to support local tourism and economic planning; also led entrepreneurship workshops and resident training programs designed to strengthen local tourism capacity and support professional certification for local guides.

experience.organization: Dinas Pekerjaan Umum, Perumahan, Dan Energi Sumber Daya Mineral Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta
experience.description: Analyzed 12 months of monitoring well data and produced 8 thematic maps to classify groundwater depth and exploitation rates across DIY; conducted pumping tests and periodic groundwater quality checks across multiple regional sites to support sustainable groundwater resource management.

aboutPoints.title: Data Analytics
aboutPoints.text: Data cleaning, SQL, Python, data visualization, dashboards, and analytical thinking.

aboutPoints.title: GIS & Geospatial
aboutPoints.text: Spatial analysis, cartography, remote sensing, WebGIS, and geospatial data processing.

aboutPoints.title: Problem Solving
aboutPoints.text: Turning raw data into structured insights and practical outputs to support informed decisions.

aboutPoints.title: Web & Visualization
aboutPoints.text: Interactive maps, web-based data presentation, and user-focused dashboards for clear communication.

projects.title: SIPTALA — Landslide Reporting WebGIS
projects.description: A WebGIS system for landslide reporting and identification of landslide-prone areas in Karanganyar. The system integrates spatial data, web mapping, and reporting features to support landslide monitoring and information management.

projects.title: RITAMAP — Dashboard RUPTL PT PLN Persero
projects.description: A geospatial mapping project developed during my experience at PLN UIP JBT, focusing on spatial data processing, visualization, and mapping to support operational information and geospatial data management.

projects.title: Sleman Foodie — Culinary WebGIS
projects.description: A WebGIS platform for exploring culinary destinations in Sleman, Yogyakarta through an interactive map-based interface. The project integrates spatial data, database management, and interactive web mapping to present location-based culinary information.

projects.title: Yogyakarta Sea Wonderland — Coastal Tourism WebGIS
projects.description: A WebGIS platform for exploring coastal tourism destinations in Gunungkidul, Yogyakarta. The project combines spatial data, interactive web mapping, and tourism information to create an accessible location-based tourism platform.

projects.title: Python-Based LiDAR Point Cloud Analysis & 3D Geospatial Modeling
projects.description: A comprehensive LiDAR point cloud analysis project combining Python, 3D geospatial processing, and machine learning. The workflow covers Drone–SLAM co-registration using Point-to-Plane ICP, point cloud classification with Random Forest, ground filtering with CSF, DSM and DTM generation, and tree volume estimation using DBSCAN clustering and voxel-based modeling.

projects.title: Advanced Geospatial Data Science
projects.description: A collection of advanced geospatial data science projects covering unstructured data processing, geovisualization, remote sensing, terrain analysis, machine learning, and deep learning. The projects include object detection, semantic and instance segmentation, DEM analysis, spectral indices, and forest and land fire probability mapping.

projects.title: Coastal & Marine Geospatial Analysis
projects.description: A collection of coastal and marine geospatial analysis projects covering benthic habitat classification, bathymetry, chlorophyll-a concentration, pelagic fish catch potential, sea surface temperature, salinity, wave formation, subsurface currents, and wave-current interactions.

projects.title: Water Resources & Groundwater Analysis
projects.description: A collection of geospatial analysis projects focused on water resources and groundwater, including watershed delineation, terrain analysis, river order classification, rainfall interpolation, water turbidity mapping, groundwater interpolation, groundwater flow direction, and groundwater depth accuracy assessment.

projects.title: Customer Behavior Dashboard — Power BI
projects.description: An interactive Power BI dashboard designed to analyze customer purchasing behavior, subscription status, demographics, product categories, revenue, shipping preferences, and customer review ratings. The dashboard provides an overview of customer segments and sales patterns to support data-driven business insights.

projects.title: HR Attrition Analysis Dashboard — Power BI
projects.description: An interactive HR analytics dashboard developed in Power BI to analyze employee attrition patterns. The dashboard explores attrition rates across departments and job roles, along with employee demographics, monthly income, tenure, overtime, and other workforce characteristics to identify potential factors associated with employee turnover.
